obligations.requirement: Five reference BrushDefinition v2 presets compile through the common pipeline and RB-03 is genuinely definition-driven and live-editable.
obligations.acceptance: 5/5 reference definitions compile; identical definition/compiler/resources reproduce ProgramIdentity; semantic RB-03 parameter edits change ProgramIdentity/output; reverting edits restores the original identity; existing V1 golden behavior remains unchanged.

obligations.requirement: Textured reference brushes resolve real immutable Shape/Grain alpha content and one deterministic common render-ready alpha resource.
obligations.acceptance: RB-03 and RB-05 resolve Shape and Grain bytes with stable hashes; common composed render resource hash is deterministic; missing/mismatched materialization fails explicitly; no backend/GPU handle enters common semantic data.

obligations.requirement: BrushDefinition v2 DAB emission is controlled by path distance and spacing rather than raw platform sample count.
obligations.oracle: CTest G45ReferenceBrushSpacing over sparse/dense equivalent geometric corpus and chunk-boundary variants.
obligations.acceptance: Sparse and dense equivalent paths yield the same stable dab positions/count/digest under frozen tolerance; spacing changes produce predictable density changes; chunked and one-shot evaluation are identical.

obligations.requirement: Preview and canonical V2 artifacts bind the same ordered primitive semantics, ProgramIdentity, render resource and deterministic seed/channel state.
obligations.acceptance: Dab ordinal, position, size, rotation and opacity are stable; preview/canonical stable primitive prefix matches; ProgramIdentity/resource hash/seed bindings match; presentation-only diagnostic tint is excluded from semantic digest.

obligations.requirement: Canonical Skia renders V2 programmable DABs from the common render-ready alpha resource rather than reducing textured references to a fixed solid path.
obligations.acceptance: RB-03/RB-04/RB-05 raster output is structurally distinct from a constant-width solid line; size/rotation/opacity edits change raster output as expected; existing canonical path-render tests stay green.

obligations.requirement: Windows ARC consumes the same common render-ready resource and mapped primitive stream without owning brush evaluation.
obligations.oracle: CTest G45WindowsArcBrushParity, Arc core resource tests and exact Windows qualification trace.
obligations.acceptance: ARC resource upload uses the same render resource ID/hash; Begin descriptor binds that resource; DAB geometry equals common primitive mapping; missing resource fails explicitly; no Arc spacing/pressure/random/family evaluator is introduced.

obligations.requirement: Space toggles only high-contrast ARC/canonical presentation colors for qualification.
obligations.acceptance: OFF uses normal colors; ON uses distinct ARC and canonical diagnostic colors; ProgramIdentity, primitive digest, resource hashes and canonical brush data do not change; any retained legacy mirror moves away from Space.

obligations.requirement: The 09F delta preserves accepted G4/G4.4/G4.5 behavior and produces an exact Windows qualification bundle plus G5 reference workload.
obligations.oracle: Relevant G4/G45 CTest, G4.5 Programmable Brush Qualification exact-result workflow, Arc/POC-06 exact-result workflow, scope audit and qualification manifest validation.
obligations.acceptance: Existing relevant tests pass; Windows/Web/Android G4.5 qualification jobs pass; Arc/POC-06 passes; no forbidden diff exists; exact Windows bundle contains the reference-brush executable/evidence path; result is READY_FOR_G4_5_10_PHYSICAL_VERIFICATION.
